scenes.heading: JSON
scenes.caption: JSON is a text format for structured data: objects of named fields, lists, numbers, text, true, false, and null. It is the usual body of a web API. It is text, so you can read it, but it is strict, so a trailing comma or a comment breaks it.

scenes.caption: Logging is writing a record of what the program did, so you can reconstruct a failure later. A useful log names the request, the decision, and the error. A useless log is either silent or a firehose of noise nobody reads.
